abstention_why: I saw the screen stay blank for hours – why didn't we take any action?
我想知道为什么今天准时毫无交易。

performance: How far popped we are from our yearly target – do we win or tie?
最近账户的盈亏大致如何？
Gives me rundown on how the portfolio fared last month.
过去一个季度的账户表现到底好吗？
What’s the net result on the ledger after the last trade wave?
decision_why: Why did you decide to lean into TechCorp last Thursday?
我好奇昨天对XXX的卖空决定为什么被认为是“最优”？
What led you to hit the buy on the T-Bill today?
昨晚的决策为什么偏向ETF之类的？
Tell me why the desk tweeted a short on ABC?
decision_list: Lay out all the moves the desk made over the past year.
请列出今日所有的操作记录。
Show me the entire roster of trades the desk went through today.
能否把前几天所有决定都做个清单？

evidence: What data backlit the price jump of XYZ this morning?
我要知道你在做那笔交易时参考了哪些信息来源。
Did you pull any fundamental reports to support yesterday’s long?
你在决定A股票时主要看了什么指标？
Mention the sources you consulted before placing that short.
calibration: Is your confidence percentile for the market steady, or does it shift?
我的模型准确率实时靠谱吗？
How reliable are the confidence levels you glimpse during the day?
你对未来的准确度预估刚好还是糟糕？
Tell me if the confidence indicator is worth trusting long term.
position: What sits in the cabinet right now?
现在的持仓到底有多少？
Which holdings are live at the moment?
你们目前持有的资产各是多少？
Show me the open positions currently in play.
session: Is the bell ringing yet, or should I wait a bit?
请问现在主场交易时间是几点到几点？
Know if the market's still on the grind or closed?
现在正处于交易日的哪一节？
Give me the break-down of the day’s trading session.
